name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare
description: Enables deployment of MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers with OAuth authentication and SSE transport. Provides a template for hosting remote MCP servers that can be accessed by Claude Desktop and other MCP clients over HTTP.
